import sys

# Read input
n, m = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())

# If there are no edges of weight 1, the weight of the minimum spanning tree is 0
if m == 0:
    print(0)
else:
    # If there are fewer than n-1 edges of weight 1, the minimum spanning tree will include all of them
    if m < n - 1:
        print(m)
    else:
        # If there are at least n-1 edges of weight 1, the minimum spanning tree will include n-1 edges
        print(n - 1)
